evidence.claim: Rule R1: Verify before you block on a weak signal: Rule R1: Verify before you block on a weak signal. If the case rests on a single signal (including a risk score alone) and your assessed fraud probability is below 0.70, recommend `VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER` or `STEP_UP_AUTH` before any block. Blocking a legitimate customer on one signal is a policy breach.

case.summary: Transaction 3514030 ($77.07) on card C12382-K1 was flagged due to a legacy real-time score of 0.61, despite a low calibrated model score of 0.071. Graph analysis showed the charge perfectly matches the holder's established weekly recurring spending pattern of approximately $77 in billing region 444. The card has no association with any fraud rings, and historical cases on the issuer bucket involved unrelated holders. Following cardholder confirmation of the charge as an authorized recurring payment, the alert was determined to be legitimate and closed as no fraud.
